arxiv-2012-14073.description: Abstract Over the last few years, the interplay between contagion dynamics of social influences (e.g., human awareness, risk perception, and information dissemination) and biological infections has been extensively investigated within the framework of multiplex networks. The vast majority of existing multiplex network spreading models typically resort to heterogeneous mean-field approximation and microscopic Markov chain approaches.

arxiv-2302-11517.title: Optimized Hard Exudate Detection with Supervised Contrastive Learning
arxiv-2302-11517.creator: Wei Tang 1,2 , Kangning Cui 1,2 \sthanks Corresponding Author., Raymond H. Chan 1,2
arxiv-2302-11517.description: Abstract Diabetic retinopathy (DR) is a leading global cause of blindness. Early detection of hard exudates plays a crucial role in identifying DR, which aids in treating diabetes and preventing vision loss. However, the unique characteristics of hard exudates, ranging from their inconsistent shapes to indistinct boundaries, pose significant challenges to existing segmentation techniques.

arxiv-2403-04584.title: Search for long-lived heavy neutrinos in the decays of \PB mesons produced in proton-proton collisions at s = 13 ​ \TeV \sqrt{s}=13\TeV
arxiv-2403-04584.description: A 2024 arXiv research paper by . A search for long-lived heavy neutrinos ( \PN ) in the decays of \PB mesons produced in proton-proton collisions at s = 13 ​ \TeV \sqrt{s}=13\TeV is presented. The data sample corresponds to an integrated luminosity of 41.6 \fbinv collected in 2018 by the CMS experiment at the CERN LHC, using a dedicated data stream that enhances the number of recorded events containing \PB mesons.

arxiv-2403-08409.title: On the universal properties of stochastic processes under optimally tuned Poisson restart
arxiv-2403-08409.creator: Sergey Belan
arxiv-2403-08409.description: Abstract Аннотация Poisson restart assumes that a stochastic process is interrupted and starts again at random time moments. A number of studies have demonstrated that this strategy may minimize the expected completion time in some classes of random search tasks.

arxiv-2408-10865.creator: Hong Xie (🖂), Jinyu Mo, Defu Lian, Jie Wang, Enhong Chen
arxiv-2408-10865.description: A 2024 arXiv research paper by Hong Xie (🖂), Jinyu Mo, Defu Lian, Jie Wang, Enhong Chen. Motivated by distributed selection problems, we formulate a new variant of multi-player multi-armed bandit (MAB) model, which captures stochastic arrival of requests to each arm, as well as the policy of allocating requests to players.

arxiv-2503-01201.title: Parameter-free Video Segmentation for Vision and Language Understanding
arxiv-2503-01201.creator: Louis Mahon, Mirella Lapata
arxiv-2503-01201.description: A 2025 arXiv research paper by Louis Mahon, Mirella Lapata. The proliferation of creative video content has driven demand for adapting language models to handle video input and enable multimodal understanding. However, end-to-end models struggle to process long videos due to their size and complexity. An effective alternative is to divide them into smaller chunks to be processed separately, and this motivates a method for choosing where the chunk boundaries should be.

arxiv-2503-05986.title: Femtosecond Temporal Phase-Resolved Nonlinear Optical Spectroscopy in Molecules with Lock-in Enabled Phase Tracking Journal: oe
arxiv-2503-05986.creator: Siddhant Pandey, \authormark 1 Francis Walz, \authormark 1 and Niranjan Shivaram \authormark 1,2,*
arxiv-2503-05986.description: Abstract We describe an experiment to measure the emitted real-time electric field from an ultrafast third-order nonlinear optical interaction in molecules, using a phase-tracked spectral interferometry scheme. By combining a software lock-in amplification based spectrometer with spectral interferometry, we measure the electric field of the nonlinear optical signal from rotationally excited gas-phase molecules.

arxiv-2506-18772.title: Patient Journey Ontology: Representing Medical Encounters for Enhanced Patient-Centric Applications
arxiv-2506-18772.creator: Hassan S. Al Khatib 1 , Subash Neupane 1 , Sudip Mittal 1 , Shahram Rahimi 2 , Nina Marhamati 3 , Sean Bozorgzad 3
arxiv-2506-18772.description: Abstract The healthcare industry is moving towards a patient-centric paradigm that requires advanced methods for managing and representing patient data. This paper presents a Patient Journey Ontology (PJO), a framework that aims to capture the entirety of a patient’s healthcare encounters.

arxiv-2511-16015.title: Exploiting Inter-Sample Information for Long-tailed Out-of-Distribution Detection
arxiv-2511-16015.creator: Nimeshika Udayangani, Hadi M. Dolatabadi, Sarah Erfani, Christopher Leckie
arxiv-2511-16015.description: Abstract Detecting out-of-distribution (OOD) data is essential for safe deployment of deep neural networks (DNNs). This problem becomes particularly challenging in the presence of long-tailed in-distribution (ID) datasets, often leading to high false positive rates (FPR) and low tail-class ID classification accuracy.

pmc-11509164.title: Development of a New Swine Model Resembling Human Empty Nose Syndrome
pmc-11509164.creator: Dan Bi Park, David W Jang, Do Hyun Kim, Sung Won Kim, Silviu Albu
pmc-11509164.description: Background and Objectives: Empty nose syndrome (ENS) is a debilitating condition that often results from traumatic or iatrogenic causes, such as nasal surgery. There are various conservative and surgical treatments for ENS, but their effectiveness remains uncertain. Therefore, the development of animal models that accurately mimic human ENS is essential for advancing effective treatment strategies.

pmc-11527793.title: Magnetic fields reveal signatures of triplet-pair multi-exciton photoluminescence in singlet fission
pmc-11527793.creator: Jiale Feng, Parisa Hosseinabadi, Damon M de Clercq, Ben P Carwithen, Michael P Nielsen, Matthew W Brett, Shyamal K K Prasad, Adam A D Farahani, Hsiu L Li, Samuel N Sanders, Jonathon E Beves, N J Ekins-Daukes, Jared H Cole, Pall Thordarson, David M Huang, Murad J Y Tayebjee, Timothy W Schmidt
pmc-11527793.description: The photophysical processes of singlet fission and triplet fusion have numerous emerging applications. They involve the separation of a photo-generated singlet exciton into two dark triplet excitons and the fusion of two dark triplet excitons into an emissive singlet exciton, respectively.

pmc-11654149.title: Investigating students’ perceptions of the medical education environment and learning autonomy in blended learning in pediatrics: a cross-sectional study
pmc-11654149.creator: Fang Liu, Ping Niu, Shiqian Yu, Li Wei, Xiaoqin He, Jingping Ye, Baozhen Yao
pmc-11654149.description: BackgroundIn the process of education reform, carrying out continuous educational environment measurement is necessary. This study aimed to evaluate the perceptions of the medical education environment and learning autonomy in blended learning in pediatrics among clinical medicine students, as well as the relationship between these two constructs.

pmc-12450917.title: Advancements and outcomes of robotic-assisted surgery in pediatric patients: a multicenter analysis
pmc-12450917.creator: Girolamo Mattioli, Giulia Rotondi, Stefano Avanzini, Michele Torre, Gaia Brenco, Carmelo Romeo, Francesco Molinaro, Marco Prestipino, Maurizio Cheli, Francesco Lacanna, Gabriella Paoli, Silvano Cincotti, Chiara Tombetti, Barbara Razore, Laura Oddera, Maria Beatrice Damasio, Andrea Michele Gino Maria
pmc-12450917.description: BackgroundRobotic surgery (RS) has gained widespread adoption in adult surgical specialties but faces unique challenges in pediatric applications due to anatomical, technical, and economic factors. This multicenter study evaluates the feasibility, clinical outcomes, and organizational implications of implementing robotic-assisted surgery in pediatric patients across various surgical disciplines.

pmc-13223596.title: Schoolboys’ experiences of information and communication regarding the human papillomavirus vaccination
pmc-13223596.creator: Eva Runngren, Mats Eriksson, Karin Blomberg
pmc-13223596.description: BackgroundTo maintain sufficient vaccination rates for human papillomavirus (HPV), it is important to understand the experiences of the target group. Boys were included in the Swedish National Immunization program for HPV more recently, in 2020, than girls, so boys’ experiences of the program are relatively underexplored.

pmc-13348798.creator: Ayşe Yücesan, Oya Nuran Emi̇roğlu, Erdem Karabulut
pmc-13348798.description: BackgroundHeart failure leads to adverse clinical and patient-reported outcomes. Its prevalence has increased markedly among adults aged 60 years and over. Transitional care interventions are recommended to address these issues; however, their effectiveness on health outcomes, particularly in older adults, remains limited and inconclusive.
